lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Mixed repair lot. Plates, sealant, capacitors. Four supply crates and you take the whole box.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: There. Enough useful parts to patch the hull and give the shield bank some life.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Fair enough. Someone with more dents will buy it.

options.line: Four crates. I will take the lot.
